title: Friend Mike secretly watched Buer and Drew race independently
summary: Charles Buer tells of Friend Mike secretly watched Buer and Drew race independently, about before 2016 at Florida, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He knew about us working on this independently for years and never told us, never did.

plain: Charles Buer, a man who says he worked on a propulsion project, tells this on a 2026 episode of a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels. He says that sometime before 2016, in Florida, he and another man, Drew, had each been working on the same kind of work separately for years, and a friend of theirs named Mike knew about both of them the whole time but never told either one. Buer tells it as a strange twist in how the work came together.
